summary: Jaguar Health filed an 8-K reporting amendments to two $12 million royalty interests (Uptown 2020, Streeterville 2022), deferring the start of monthly payments from October 1, 2026 to January 1, 2027, with minimum monthly Royalty Payments now the greater of $750,000 or the amount otherwise owed under Section 2.1. Jaguar also amended a $6,220,812.50 secured promissory note with Streeterville. These are routine liability-management/credit-facility modifications under Items 1.01 and 2.03, not a change of control, tender, or capital-return event. Watch cash-flow runway and amended covenant compliance.
